why: An arXiv preprint by Garonzi and Margolis (Sept 2025) proves the Herzog-Schönheim conjecture for all finite simple groups and all symmetric groups, settling a class of the general conjecture while it remains open overall.

found.title: The Herzog-Schönheim conjecture for simple and symmetric groups
found.note: Preprint by Garonzi and Margolis proving the conjecture for finite simple groups and symmetric groups; not read.
